purpose: Resolution-level AGM voting history for governance and activist contestability research.
method_note: Newer DART AGM-result tables provide vote percentages and can support contestability scoring. Older AGM formats are preserved as agenda/result history, including shareholder proposals, but are not assigned inferred vote percentages.

agm_summary.interpretation: Contestability score uses only meetings with vote percentages. Legacy shareholder proposals are counted as history but do not add quantitative score points without voting percentages.
